hero.plainLine: Treating brain and spine blood-vessel conditions through a small catheter, and without open surgery where suitable.

brainAneurysm.summary: A weak, bulging spot in a brain artery

stroke.summary: A blocked or bleeding brain vessel; timing matters

avm.summary: An abnormal tangle of blood vessels in the brain or spine

carotidStenosis.summary: Narrowing of the neck artery that feeds the brain

venousSinusDisorders.summary: Narrowing or clots in veins that drain the brain

chronicSubduralHaematoma.summary: A slow collection of blood on the brain's surface, often after a head injury

biography.body: Dr. Mohamed Aggour is a Consultant Interventional Neuroradiologist with more than nineteen years of experience treating brain and spine blood-vessel diseases through catheter-based, minimally invasive procedures.

conditions.emergencyBody: If symptoms appear suddenly (weakness, face drooping, trouble speaking, or a severe sudden headache), call your local emergency number immediately. Remote consultation is not for emergencies.
